formula: mean over activity windows of abs(rfft(original sensor values, axis=time))**2
retained_preprocessing: All original HAR preprocessing remains; raw means no additional spectral processing
physical_quantity: unnormalized squared DFT magnitude, NOT PSD density
display: 0–35 Hz; beyond 25 Hz dashed mirrored values at 50-f; log y-axis
filter_annotation: Dataset 20 Hz low-pass, not an assertion of a sharp drop in this raw FFT
